world.premise: Sebuah kerajaan kuno terkubur oleh wabah bayangan ribuan tahun lalu. Cerita beredar bahwa di kedalaman terdalam, ada sesuatu yang memanggil — relic, kutukan, mungkin tuhan. Kau adalah scavenger, penjelajah, atau penebus dosa yang turun ke dalamnya.

floors.the_forgotten_crypts: Di sini para penjaga makam masih berjaga, dalam caranya sendiri.
floors.halls_of_echoes: Setiap langkah berbalik. Kadang dengan satu langkah lebih.
floors.the_bone_garden: Tidak semua yang tumbuh memerlukan tanah.

enemies.goblin_scout: Pencuri kecil yang tinggal terlalu lama di tempat yang salah.
enemies.skeleton_archer: Bersumpah setia pada seorang raja yang sudah tidak ada lagi.
enemies.shadow_wraith: Pernah punya nama. Lupa, tapi marah.

items.greater_health_potion: Brewed by a hand that knew loss.
items.blood_cordial: It heals. It also remembers what fed it.
items.iron_sword: Forged for someone who never came back.
items.bone_hatchet: Hewn from a femur that disagreed.
items.hunters_bow: The string still smells of pine resin and patience.
items.soulreaper_scythe: The harvest does not care for season.
items.witchfire_brand: Still warm. Even when set down.
items.frostbite_pick: Pulled from a glacier that no one mapped.
items.obsidian_shard: All edge, no balance. Just like its owner was.
items.mythril_blade: Cold to the touch even in a hot hand.
items.heartseeker_rapier: Finds the gap. Always the gap.
items.padded_tunic: More comfortable than it looks. Less useful, too.
items.leather_armor: Stitched by a tailor with no eye for fashion.
items.scale_hauberk: Scales overlapped by patient, dead hands.
items.wraithcloak: Steps fall softer. So does sleep, eventually.
items.plated_mail: Heavier than it looks. The previous wearer is, too, somewhere down here.
items.bone_cuirass: The ribs were not yours. They are now.
items.cinder_robe: Lighter than ash. Older than fire.
items.ironheart_shard: A heart that learned to be stone.
items.heart_crystal: Beats in time with something that should not be alive.
items.tome_of_wisdom: The pages turn themselves when no one watches.
items.ancient_codex: You do not read it. You let it read you.
items.strength_elixir: Tastes like a brawl you survived.
items.iron_skin_tonic: The skin remembers what the mind forgets.
items.berserkers_brew: Six turns of clarity. Then the bill.
items.long_vigil_tea: The watchers drank it. The watchers stayed.
items.phantom_vial: Slow, quiet, lasting. Like the dead.
items.plague_flask: Sealed in a hurry. Whoever sealed it was hopeful.
items.fire_bomb: Burns whatever it touches. You included.
items.voidshard: A piece of what's underneath. Smaller than expected.
items.pyre_capsule: For when funeral rites can wait.
items.scroll_of_mapping: Whoever drew this map did not return for it.
items.scroll_of_foresight: The future, briefly. Then the headache.
items.scroll_of_recall: Remembers a kinder body for you.
items.revive_charm: It will let you come back once. Once.
items.bone_talisman: Knuckles, drilled and strung. Yours, now.
items.twin_charm: Two breaths borrowed from a brother who couldn't use them.
